diagnosis: Spring Data REST automatically exposes standard CRUD endpoints for CustomerPaymentMethod entities under /payment-methods/{id}. Because no repository-level security annotations or RepositoryEventHandlers are defined, any authenticated customer can view stored credit card tokens, cardholder billing addresses, and expiration dates belonging to other shoppers.
